title: Example follow-up priority
question: How urgent is follow-up documentation for this sample record?
rule: Sum each criterion weight multiplied by its reviewer-assigned rating. Ratings are 0 (low priority), 0.5 (medium priority), or 1 (high priority). A missing rating withholds the whole score. No weights are redistributed.

criteria.label: Documentation gaps
criteria.description: How much do gaps in the available method record limit further review?

criteria.label: Value of follow-up
criteria.description: How useful would a more complete procedure and uncertainty account be?

criteria.label: Version preservation
criteria.description: How important is it to preserve exact source versions while follow-up proceeds?
